mapper.sql: select a.application_id, a.student_id, u.nick_name student_name, a.reason, a.planned_start, a.planned_end, a.status, a.mentor_comment, a.admin_comment, a.workstation_id, w.workstation_no, a.create_time from gw_mobile_application a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.student_id left join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id = a.workstation_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from gw_mobile_application where student_id = #{studentId} and status in ('PENDING_MENTOR','PENDING_ADMIN','WAIT_ALLOC')
mapper.insert: insert into gw_mobile_application(student_id, reason, planned_start, planned_end, status, create_by, create_time) values(#{studentId}, #{reason}, #{plannedStart}, #{plannedEnd}, 'PENDING_MENTOR', #{studentId}, now())
mapper.update: update gw_mobile_application set status = #{status}, mentor_comment = #{comment}, mentor_review_time = now() where application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'PENDING_MENTOR' and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile p where p.user_id=gw_mobile_application.student_id and p.mentor_id=#{mentorId})
update gw_mobile_application set status = #{status}, admin_comment = #{comment}, admin_review_time = now() where application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'PENDING_ADMIN'
update gw_mobile_application set status = #{status}, workstation_id = #{workstationId}, update_time = now() where application_id = #{applicationId} and status = 'WAIT_ALLOC'
mapper.insert: insert into gw_assignment(student_id, workstation_id, application_id, started_at, operator_id, create_time) values(#{studentId}, #{workstationId}, #{applicationId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from gw_assignment where student_id = #{studentId} and ended_at is null
